notes.title: Patch 1.2.4 Notes
notes.content:
I think we are overdue for an update to Rustbucket Rumble.  Today's patch adds some cool new stuff and fixes some of the most painful bugs.

First off: [b]HATS![/b]  You can now outfit your robots with a hat to make sure they are looking good.  Some hats can be earned by leveling up, while others can be bought on Steam.  Hit the [b]Customize[/b] button on the main menu and find a look that suits you!

We've also changed the way free characters work.  Previously, all players had access to the same 2 free characters each week.  This led to games where only those two characters were present, which gets boring pretty quickly.  We've changed it so that each player gets 2 different free characters each week.  So I may have [b]Clancy[/b] and [b]Kasumi[/b] this week, but you may have [b]Bjorn[/b] and [b]Valentina[/b].  We hope that this change will create much more variety in team comps and more interesting matches.

Let us know what you think of the changes in the comments!

[h1]New Content / Features [/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a [b]Customize[/b] button to the main menu.
[*]Added 2 hats as rewards for reaching level [b]15[/b] and [b]35[/b].
[*]Added 4 hats that are available for purchase.
[*]Each player now gets a different 2 free characters each week.
[/list]
[h1]Visual Polish[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Kasumi's Clones[/b] now throw smoke bombs when they vanish.
[*]Team Scraps are now filled with gold to make them more visually distinct from stunned robots.
[*]Made the Giant Robot's distance from the camera more consistent across the different maps.
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Kasumi's Teleport[/b] no longer fails if grounded on the [b]Scrap Yard[/b].
[*]The [b]Giant Robot[/b] won't eat things that are held by [b]Robots[/b] or [b]Carry Drones[/b].
[*][b]Scraps[/b] don't stay invisible if a [b]Kasumi[/b] player disconnects while carrying them.
[*][b]Bjorn[/b] can't [b]Throw[/b] people through the roof of the [b]Foundry[/b] anymore.
[*]Restored the ability to invite friends to [b]Custom Games[/b].
[*]Made some minor performance improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 Notes
notes.content:
[h1][b]Notes for the smaller patch 1.1.2[/b][/h1]
[i]Patch [b]1.1.2[/b] is very tiny.  All it changed was the way we help clients find the servers to connect to.[/i]

[h1][b]Notes for the smaller patch 1.1.1[/b][/h1]
[i]We just pushed a very small change for patch 1.1.1.  This patch resolved 2 pesky networking issues:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that could prevent newcomers from joining existing lobbies when using the [b]Play Now[/b] button.
[*]Fixed a bug that made it impossible to start a custom game if the host left before character select.
[/list][/i]

[h1][b]Notes for the larger patch 1.1.0[/b][/h1]
Hey there, Rustbucket Rumblers!

Today we deployed patch [b]1.1.0[/b], which has major changes to the way we handle networking, as well as a few other things.

Before today's patch, each match was hosted by one of the players, and the other players in the match connected to that person's machine.  This meant that we (the developers) didn't have a lot of control over the connection quality, as it varied greatly with the selected host's network configuration.

But as of patch [b]1.1.0[/b], we have special dedicated servers located [i]across the globe![/i]  Now we can guarantee that the machine hosting the match will be easy to connect to and have a fast upload speed.  That means fewer failed connections, fewer disconnections, and less lag.

Here are the full patch notes:

[h1]Networking[/h1]
[list]
[*]Dedicated Servers across the globe!
[/list]
[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Giant Robot health recovered now [b]100 hp per point scored[/b] (was [b]250 per bin recycled[/b])
[*]Giant Robot healing aura now [b]3 hp / second[/b] (down from [b]5 hp / second[/b])
[*]Giant Robot undistracted time now [b]3 seconds[/b] (down from [b]4 seconds[/b])
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Gameplay related achievements are no longer earned during a tutorial.
[*]Tutorials no longer end immediately if played after a ranked game.
[/list]
[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]
[list]
[*]Additional information now provided about number of players found when searching for a game.
[*]Connection strength UI is now a bit more forgiving about what it considers a good connection, as we found gameplay was not as sensitive to lag as we originally anticipated.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.11 Notes
notes.content:
Hey there, Rustbucket Rumblers!

Patch [b]1.0.11[/b] was deployed this morning.  This patch has some improvements to networking and host selection as well as badge rewards for leveling up.

We've heard your feedback loud and clear that connection issues are a real pain.  This patch contains a number of improvements that we wanted to get live as quickly as possible.  That said, we're not done yet.  We're still actively working on the networking experience, so you can look forward to seeing even more improvements in the future.

Okay, enough chatter.  Here are the actual patch notes:

[h1]New Content / Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added three new badges as rewards for reaching level [b]10[/b], [b]25[/b], and [b]50[/b].
[*] Added a [b]Store[/b] button to the main menu.
[*] Updated the layout of the post game screens to provide more information.
[/list]
[h1]Networking[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved host selection when using the [b]Play Now[/b] button.
[*] Reduced message spam when searching for a game.
[*] Disconnected players' stats now appear in the stats screen.
[*] Return to the Match Lobby screen if a player drops at character select.
[*] Game ends instantly if all opponents drop from a ranked game.

notes.title: FAQs and answers to some questions
notes.content:
Hi!

Thanks for downloading and playing Rustbucket Rumble! We've got some answers to questions we've been seeing pop up on our Community Hub - see below:

[b]I'm having trouble connecting to a match - is there anything I can do?[/b]
If you’re having trouble connecting, make sure UPnP is enabled on your home router.
If you’re still having trouble, try forwarding the port 25000 from your home router interface.
If neither of these solutions helps you, contact our [url=http://www.rustbucketrumble.com/contact] customer service [/url]

[b]How does your free-to-play mechanism work?[/b]
As you've seen, each week we make 2 of the robots available for you to use. If you've purchased the DLC pack, you can use all 6 robots whenever you want. If you haven't purchased the DLC, you can keep a robot for the next week if you win 10 ranked games.

[b]Can I keep a robot forever as long as I keep winning?[/b]
Yes! As long as you win at least 10 ranked games each week with a robot, you get to keep it for the next week - regardless of whether you had it last week or not. In theory, you can keep all 6 robots for forever, as long as you win 10 ranked games each week with each robot!


I hope these address some of your concerns. We are actively reading through all discussions and comments here and want you to know we're making tweaks and updates based on what we're hearing, so thanks for being active!

- Rustbucket Rumble Dev Team
